reference.method: Individually reviewed roof runs: two observed eave endpoints in reference pixels plus approximate perpendicular roof depth. These are approximate roofprints, not surveyed ground footprints. No random infill.
reference.currentContext: User supplied current district map and independently reviewed named community photographs corroborate the built-up neighbourhoods. They do not establish a newer acquisition date for this satellite image.
reference.limitations: Satellite roof lean, trees and shadows limit outline precision. 2026 service publication is not the imagery acquisition date. Heights and roof pitch are display estimates unless separately documented.

limitations: Unlabelled heights and landuse-derived uses remain estimates.
Satellite roofprints and model heights do not reconstruct photographed facades.
CNBH is a 2020 model at 10 m resolution; mixed pixels and new construction limit individual-building accuracy.
3D-GloBFP, when available, represents 2020 and uses model-estimated heights.
